integrity: The theorem is proved structurally. The bundled finite checker is a consistency test and is not treated as evidence for the infinite quantified step. Literature overlap was compared at statement and implication level.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite weak orders (ordinal sums of antichains). Weak equivalence is classified as weak homotopy type, not as existence of a weak-equivalence map in both directions.
title: Homotopy versus weak homotopy classification of finite weak orders
